disclosure: Research-only candidate registry. Provisional scores are not canonical ranking scores; no candidate has earned lifecycle maturity or commercial validation.

candidates.name: Agent Protocol Composition Release Gate
candidates.whatWouldKill: A free official conformance suite covers multi-protocol composition, auth, replay, delegation, and regression evidence well enough that vendors will not pay.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Expanded from MCP-only testing to MCP/A2A composition, chained delegation, credential lifecycle, and signed release evidence.
negativeEvidence: AgentRFC and protocol-native tooling are substitutes
Enterprise auth fixtures are costly to maintain

candidates.name: eFTI Interoperability & Certification Regression Lab
candidates.whatWouldKill: Official reference implementations become comprehensive, free, and certification-grade across national implementations.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: New wedge beside eFTI platforms: schema, authorization, disclosure, QR/access, cross-border, negative-case, and version regression testing.
negativeEvidence: eFTI platforms and consortium tooling already exist
Public reference tooling could absorb the wedge

candidates.name: DPP Semantic Preflight + Registry Diff
candidates.whatWouldKill: Registry validation is too permissive or DPP platforms bundle equivalent lint and reverse-reconciliation at no incremental price.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Narrowed generic DPP platform ambition to dpp-lint and dpp-diff against the live registry/API boundary.
negativeEvidence: Platform vendors may build the feature in-house

candidates.name: Methane MRV Contract Evidence Gate
candidates.whatWouldKill: Importers accept supplier attestations without a reusable evidence gate or implementation guidance materially changes the proof burden.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Framed as manual contract/evidence-route discovery first, not a large SaaS build.
negativeEvidence: Energy incumbents and consultants already own relationships

candidates.name: CloudExit Execution Drill / Verified Evacuation SLO
candidates.whatWouldKill: EscapeCloud/open-source export tooling plus internal runbooks provide accepted restore evidence at lower cost.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Rewritten from generic portability assessment to executable export, restore, identity, and application-journey drills.
negativeEvidence: Cloud providers may improve exit tooling

candidates.name: Data-Centre Flexibility SLA Verifier / GridFlex Proof
candidates.whatWouldKill: Utilities and aggregators do not accept third-party flexibility evidence or telemetry is already contractually sufficient.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Separated operating-flexibility proof from DemandProof/LoadLedger project-readiness identity.
negativeEvidence: DemandProof overlap must be resolved by buyer evidence needs

candidates.name: EUDAMED Regulatory-Data Drift Gate / Registered-State Integrity
candidates.whatWouldKill: Existing medical-device systems already perform complete reverse reconciliation or customers only buy submission software.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Generic EUDAMED submission is rejected; only continuous registry/internal-system drift remains in scope.

candidates.name: Physical-AI Field Update Evidence Gate / Fleet Field-Update Gate
candidates.whatWouldKill: Ketryx-like incumbents cover deployed-fleet update evidence and buyers see no meaningful gap.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Generic Physical-AI compliance traceability rejected; only field-update release evidence remains.

candidates.name: PQC Crypto-Agility Swap Test
candidates.whatWouldKill: Inventory vendors and cloud crypto-agility tooling already execute accepted application-level swaps.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Narrowed from inventory platform to application/provider/certificate swap behavior and evidence.
negativeEvidence: Migration tests can be internal scripts

candidates.name: Forced-Labour Investigation Response Room
candidates.whatWouldKill: BorderGraph/EvidenceGraph modules satisfy recurring investigation workflows without a standalone buyer budget.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Kept as an investigation-stage evidence room, not generic due-diligence SaaS.
negativeEvidence: Regulation itself does not impose a general audit/reporting obligation

candidates.name: CLP Artwork-to-Commerce Drift Gate
candidates.whatWouldKill: Existing label/web scanners already compare every relevant surface and regulation remains too volatile for stable acceptance tests.
candidates.changedSinceLastResearch: Generic e-commerce checker rejected; retained multi-surface render-to-shelf consistency.
negativeEvidence: Buyer may treat drift as internal QA
